stories.summary: Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned as U.S. ambassador to Greece after the White House asked her to step down, while denying allegations that she offered access to Trump administration officials in exchange for money. Reports say the allegations include a $100,000 payment request, diplomatic misconduct and hostile-workplace claims at the U.S. Embassy. President Donald Trump subsequently distanced himself from Guilfoyle, who previously dated his eldest son.

stories.title: French supermarket director apologises after cyber-attack spoils fresh and frozen food - video
stories.summary: A cyberattack disrupted refrigeration across several hundred French supermarkets, sending temperatures as high as 50C overnight and causing widespread food losses. At Intermarché La Haye, store director Julien Freret said fridge temperatures reached 27C and all fresh and frozen stock was lost, prompting an apology to customers.

stories.title: AI godfather Geoffrey Hinton: ‘We’re creating alien beings. I’m willing to be selfish and choose humans’
stories.summary: Computer scientist Geoffrey Hinton warns that artificial intelligence could threaten humanity and describes advanced systems as alien beings. He also criticizes Donald Trump’s use of the term “superintelligence” and argues that people may struggle to accept that humans are not the only intelligent beings.
